news.catch: Activists say permission for a cultural programme at Manaveeyam Veedhi featuring singer Pushpavathy was sought well in advance on November 3. They accuse the Mayor of curbing freedom of expression.

news.catch: An FIR was registered against the TMC MP following a complaint about his social media post in May that allegedly targeted Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and Gujaratis during the Assembly poll period

news.h: Electors face Form 6 and enumeration form quandary
news.catch: Electors in Hyderabad’s Kukatpally and nearby constituencies face confusion after the Election Commission on November 6 announced that voters listed as ASDD could refile Enumeration Forms, even after submitting Form 6. This has sparked mismatches and questions about eligibility and penalties

quiz.q: Who took charge as the Chief of Defence Staff in May 2026?
quiz.e: General N. S. Raja Subramani became the third CDS on 31 May 2026; General Dhiraj Seth took over as Army chief on 30 June.

quiz.q: Who was appointed Chief of the Air Staff in October 2026?
o: Air Chief Marshal A. P. Singh
Air Chief Marshal V. R. Chaudhari
Air Marshal R. K. S. Bhadauria
quiz.e: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit took charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on 31 October 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A. P. Singh.

quiz.q: Who is the Chief of the Naval Staff, who took charge on 31 May 2026?
quiz.e: Admiral Krishna Swaminathan took over as the 27th Chief of the Naval Staff on 31 May 2026, the same day as the new CDS.

quiz.q: Who is the Chief of the Army Staff of India?
quiz.e: General Dhiraj Seth took charge as the 31st Chief of the Army Staff on 30 June 2026.

quiz.q: Who is the Chief Justice of India?
quiz.e: Justice Surya Kant is the 53rd Chief Justice of India, having taken office in November 2025.

quiz.q: Who is the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India?
quiz.e: Sanjay Malhotra is the 26th Governor of the RBI and chairs the Monetary Policy Committee.

quiz.q: Who is the Chief Election Commissioner of India?
quiz.e: Gyanesh Kumar is the 26th Chief Election Commissioner. The Election Commission conducts elections to Parliament, State legislatures and the offices of President and Vice-President.

quiz.q: The Sixteenth Finance Commission, whose recommendations were accepted in the 2026-27 Budget, is chaired by:
quiz.e: Arvind Panagariya chairs the Sixteenth Finance Commission, which recommended retaining the States' vertical share of central taxes at 41 per cent.

quiz.q: In the 2026 Assembly elections, who became the first Bharatiya Janata Party Chief Minister of West Bengal?
quiz.e: Suvendu Adhikari was sworn in on 9 May 2026 after the BJP won 207 of the 294 seats, ending Trinamool Congress rule since 2011.

quiz.q: Who became Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu in May 2026?
quiz.e: Actor-politician C. Joseph Vijay of the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam was sworn in on 10 May 2026 after his party won 108 seats in the 234-member Assembly.
